features.managerCorrections: Allow manager/admin to correct employee expenses (audit trail)
features.batchEntry: Allow batch expense entry (submit multiple expenses in one wizard)
features.dailyProjectExpenseReport: Daily project expense report (employee × project per day)
features.transferRecipientAcceptance: Transfer recipient acceptance (pending offers before credit)
features.cashierAccountantMode: Cashier accountant mode (read-only reports for designated cashiers)
features.baseFieldInputCustomization: Customizable base field inputs (change text/number/dropdown in form builder)
features.userActivityInsights: User Activity Insights (track visible app activity, last seen, inactivity trends)
features.employeeTransferHistory: Employee Balance History (employees can view balance credits recorded to their account)
features.historicalBalanceV2: Historical Balance (Opening Balance, Balance Update, Tally import) -- requires backend update
features.expenseFieldMemory: Expense Field Memory (recently-used title/destination/purpose suggestions per employee)
features.expenseDateLocking: Expense Date Locking (admins can block submissions for selected dates/months/ranges)
